tweets.text: Hey kick fix your gifted sub system. @KICKEthan $1583.60 in charge backs WTF. Your site is cooked. AND my stream from yesterday was wiped so about $1700 total.
as far as i'm concerned kick stole the $. They need to drop me 500 subs IMMEDIATLY

MastuhSplinter went on a gift spree during and right after the #SeeEx event, sending thousands of subs to several Kick streamers. Now he has charged it all back. I'll be fine, but this type of thing absolutely destroys some creators. The unfortunate part is because it's subs, paid through Stripe Express, we have no recourse. The refunds show minimal information and no way to fight it. I hope Kick at least tries to fight these on our behalf.

Kick user MASTUHSPLINTER has charged back over $10,000 in Gifted Subs and Kicks to various Streamers, forcing the fraudulent money to be owed back by the Streamer in future Kick payouts. The user also remains as the Top Lifetime Gifter and Kick Donator on all channels.
tweets.note: The $10,000+ figure is this account's claim. It is not confirmed by Kick or by the affected streamers' own numbers.

evidence.title: Kick Support confirms the deductions were chargebacks
evidence.caption: Email from Kick Support read on wvagabond's stream, 10 Oct 2026. It confirms the deductions were chargebacks, says Kick cannot disclose the other user's details, and that Kick Support cannot reverse them or restore the earnings.
evidence.alt: Email from Kick Support: deductions to creator earnings were the result of chargebacks; Kick cannot reverse them.

evidence.title: The refunds, one sub at a time
evidence.caption: wvagabond's Stripe Express ledger filtered to payment refunds: a column of "Refund on Kick Streaming, Ltd" rows at -$4.74 each, which is $4.99 less Kick's 5%.
evidence.alt: Stripe ledger showing many Payment Refund rows of -$4.74 labelled Refund on Kick Streaming, Ltd.

evidence.title: The gifts, as Kick logged them
evidence.caption: The same dashboard's subscription log for 28 Sept 2026: MASTUHSPLINTER gifting one subscription at a time, via Google billing, minutes apart.
evidence.alt: Kick creator dashboard rows: Sep 28, 2026, Google, MASTUHSPLINTER, Gifted 1 subscription, repeated.
